summary: Bejeweled entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Bejeweled
entries.definitive_edition: Bejeweled Deluxe/original PopCap PC build with exact source/build documented

emulation.notes: Native old PC route; browser/mobile routes only for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PC/Deluxe build with exact mode, source, and score/timer state documented

primary.version: Bejeweled Deluxe / original PopCap PC route where owned
primary.why: Bejeweled's original web/PC PopCap route is the match-three baseline, but current availability is fragmented across older PC builds and later mobile/classic versions. Archive the exact build because Deluxe, web, mobile, and later Bejeweled entries differ.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally owned Bejeweled Deluxe/original PC build where available. Record build/source, Classic versus Timed mode, resolution/windowed state, input, score/timer, audio, and whether mobile Classic or later Bejeweled 2/3 were excluded.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting that platform route.
secondary.why: The original PC/Deluxe route is the cleanest baseline for this entry.

all_releases.fidelity: Port routes with different UI/platform constraints.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original web, Deluxe PC, mobile, and later Bejeweled sequels are distinct route scopes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Bejeweled 2, Bejeweled 3, Twist, Blitz, or Stars.
